tasks.short: Enforce school discipline and attendance rules fairly

steps.what: Verify facts with student and staff

loop.check: Administrator checks facts, tone and policy wording before sending.
loop.stop: One draft; sensitive or disputed cases are written manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: The message needs case-specific explanation in free text.

tasks.design: A restricted {HCM} case record collects an absence or incident report and puts the applicable policy and review date in one place. The administrator still verifies the account, weighs context and writes or approves any communication; the system does not impose discipline.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rules are documented, but fair application depends on disputed facts and the student's circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: A case record can connect reports, policy references, communications and follow-up dates.
tasks.still_hard: The administrator must hear people, make a proportionate decision and handle disagreement.
tasks.human_edge: They can test conflicting accounts and exercise care before an action affects a student.

ambition.what: Review recurring attendance barriers before they become discipline cases.

tasks.altitude: The administrator reviews patterns and overdue follow-up rather than assembling case files from separate messages.

evidence.claim: Rules and case facts can be brought together for a human decision.
A student-affecting decision should not rest solely on automated processing.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: report received through follow-up date recorded.
Input contract: student identifier, report type, date, reporter, factual account and linked policy; staff produces the report; a restricted manual case note is the fallback.
Incremental upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers policy links and case categories.
unknowns: Which actions require a second school leader's approval.
Whether current records separate attendance from disciplinary incidents.
research_questions: How many cases lack a complete factual account?
Which attendance patterns can be addressed before an incident occurs?

already_counted.description: Fact verification, contextual decision and communication review

incremental.description: Maintain policy links and case categories

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Fact finding and the decision remain human; only case assembly, record entry and first communication draft are reduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit, hire, train, and evaluate school staff

steps.what: Recruit staff for a defined vacancy
Train and evaluate newly hired staff

tasks.design: Use {ATS}, {LMS} and {TALENT} configuration to keep the vacancy, applicant stages, induction tasks and early review visible. People define the need, interview, assess evidence and choose a candidate; the workflow never ranks or rejects applicants autonomously.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hiring and performance assessment mix structured stages with high-consequence human judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing recruitment, learning and performance records can share a requisition and induction identifier.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing suitability, references and team fit requires accountable human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator can probe evidence, notice safeguarding concerns and explain a selection decision.

ambition.what: Give every new staff member a visible first-term induction and support plan.

tasks.altitude: The administrator improves induction completion and evidence quality instead of manually chasing stage updates.

evidence.claim: Recruitment, learning and review stages can be configured in dedicated systems.
Employment selection needs accountable human involvement.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: staffing need agreed through early performance review recorded.

Input contract: role, duties, required credentials, interview evidence, reference status and induction tasks; hiring manager and candidate provide the fields; a structured interview pack is the manual fallback.
Incremental upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers stage definitions and induction content.
unknowns: Who has authority to issue an offer and complete background checks.
Which staff categories use supplemental rather than standard hiring routes.
research_questions: Where do candidates and hiring managers wait between stages?
Which induction tasks predict a successful first-term review?

already_counted.description: Vacancy definition, interviews, selection and review

incremental.description: Maintain hiring stages and induction paths

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Interviews, selection and substantive performance review are retained; savings come from stage coordination and induction tracking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on curriculum standards, mission, performance goals, and objectives

steps.what: Gather curriculum evidence and teacher feedback
Draft standards, mission and goal options

loop.input: workshop themes, existing standards and evidence pack
loop.output: alternative standards and measurable goal draft
loop.check: Administrator checks every option against workshop notes and source evidence.
loop.stop: One bounded draft; contradictions or missing evidence go back to the workshop.
loop.why_not_simpler: The output needs coherent policy language from unstructured discussion.

steps.what: Reconcile feedback and maintain standard register

tasks.design: A {BI} evidence pack and {WORKFLOW} register keep proposed standards, goals, owners and review dates traceable. Teachers and the administrator create the meaning together; drafting support only structures the discussion for review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mission and curriculum standards emerge through professional debate, not a stable set of rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared evidence, versioned drafts and a goal register can make the collaborative work easier to revisit.
tasks.still_hard: The school must reconcile differing educational values and decide what quality means locally.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator builds consent and interprets evidence with teachers who know their pupils.

ambition.what: Review progress against each curriculum goal at every term boundary.

tasks.altitude: The administrator curates evidence and resolves trade-offs rather than consolidating workshop documents.

evidence.claim: Versioned documents and goal registers can support collaborative policy work.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: evidence assembled through revised standards and goals recorded.
Input contract: standard identifier, evidence source, teacher proposal, goal measure, owner and review date; teachers and data staff provide the fields; workshop notes are the manual fallback.
Incremental upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers register taxonomy and review cycles.
unknowns: Which standards are mandated versus locally adaptable.
Who must endorse a change before it is published.
research_questions: Which goal measures are trusted by teachers?
How often do standards change after consultation?

already_counted.description: Workshop, option review and feedback reconciliation

incremental.description: Maintain goal register and evidence taxonomy

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Teacher collaboration and policy judgement remain human; savings are limited to evidence assembly, drafting and tracking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set educational standards, goals, policies, and operating procedures

steps.what: Review outcome evidence and policy register
Set educational priorities and goal measures

loop.input: approved priorities and marked-up existing policy
loop.output: policy and procedure draft with changed sections
loop.check: Administrator compares every change to the approved priority and underlying source.
loop.stop: One draft version; unresolved wording is edited manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: Policy language and local procedures are free text with context-dependent exceptions.

steps.what: Publish version and set review reminders

tasks.design: A versioned {DOCS} policy register links review evidence, draft changes, consultation feedback and the next review date. The administrator and school leadership set standards and settle procedure trade-offs; the workflow only makes the change history and reminders dependable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policies are text, but their practical meaning appears through consultation and exceptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Version control, evidence links and review-date notifications can be configured without automating the policy decision.
tasks.still_hard: The school must decide what standard is fair, workable and consistent with its obligations.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator translates broad goals into procedures that staff can use and challenge.

ambition.what: Give staff a visible current-policy register with an owner and next review date.

tasks.altitude: The administrator manages policy quality and evidence instead of chasing uncontrolled document copies.

reach.learn: version governance and change impact assessment

evidence.claim: Versioned policy registers can track owners, changes and review dates.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: policy evidence reviewed through version published and review date set.
Input contract: policy identifier, owner, evidence link, proposed change, consultation feedback and review date; policy owner supplies the fields; controlled document upload is the fallback.
Incremental upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers version metadata and reminder rules.
unknowns: Which policies need formal board or external approval.
Where staff currently find the authoritative procedure.
research_questions: How many active policies lack a named owner or review date?
Which implementation questions recur after a policy changes?

already_counted.description: Priority setting, draft review and implementation consultation

incremental.description: Maintain policy metadata and review rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Policy choices and implementation consultation remain manual; savings come from evidence assembly, version handling and reminders.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The administrator stays accountable for student and staff decisions while making the school’s case, hiring, curriculum and policy records more usable.
reach: Work with attendance officers on evidence quality.
Work with curriculum coordinators on review registers.
role.ambitious_version: A school leader who can see whether decisions, standards and procedures are being followed and improved.
